purpose: Uncertainty sensitivity for the locked test metrics.
method: True-label-stratified paired nonparametric percentile bootstrap of fixed test rows; PASS and FAIL counts are preserved in each replicate.
caution: Intervals condition on this fixed model, threshold, test sampling frame, and observed 21/314 FAIL prevalence. They exclude training, model-selection, and threshold-selection uncertainty; they do not make all metrics invalid and are not an external performance guarantee.
